## How this was produced

ProductForge researched Tasklet (https://tasklet.example) from public sources, reconstructed its
features, workflows and domain model with explicit confidence, reduced it to a V1, and designed an
independent architecture. Nothing here is copied from Tasklet; `research/` records every
source and claim.
